copy.tagline: 用代码直接操控浏览器完成自动化操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用程序控制浏览器执行重复操作或测试
copy.tagline_en: Control browsers directly via code for automation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for repetitive tasks or testing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以直接控制浏览器，执行打开网页、点击、填写表单、截图、抓取数据等操作。它会自动连接本地 Chrome，或使用云端浏览器完成复杂任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 在浏览器中执行操作（如搜索、填表、截图）时触发。如果任务涉及特定网站且启用了领域技能，Claude 会先读取该网站的专用指南。

say.text: 帮我打开百度，搜索“天气”。
say.note: Claude 会新建标签页，导航到百度并执行搜索。
Claude 会调用截图功能并保存文件。

say.text: 用云端浏览器同时抓取两个网站的数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can directly control a browser to open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, etc. It connects to local Chrome or uses cloud browsers for complex tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to perform browser actions (e.g., search, fill forms, screenshot). If domain skills are enabled and the task is site-specific, Claude reads the site's guide first.

say_en.note: Claude will open a new tab, navigate to Baidu, and perform the search.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page and save it.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the screenshot and save the file.

say_en.text: Use a cloud browser to scrape data from two sites simultaneously.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using Browser Use cloud for parallel tasks.
